posts.title: WELCOME TO THE WORKSHOP
posts.text:
The home of **GD's Melee**: native PC Melee, rollback netplay, mod support, Lua scripting and the LAB.

**Play the public build**
v0.2.2 is the latest published release, for Windows and Linux. Windows and Linux players can play each other online. Start with #rules and #downloads.

**Explore development**
Linux performance work, the map editor and a roguelite campaign are active development work. They are ahead of the public release; follow #announcements for status.

Find sets in #matchmaking, ask in #help-and-setup, report bugs in #bug-reports, and share work in #clips-and-creations. Choose your interests in Channels & Roles.

posts.title: PROJECT STATUS | OCTOBER 8, 2026
posts.text:
**Public release: v0.2.2 for Windows and Linux**
Download it in #downloads. Windows and Linux play each other online (netplay protocol 5); every player needs 0.2.2 (0.2.1 and earlier cannot match). Since 0.1.7 the release adds fullscreen (F11 or Alt+Enter), an in-game mod browser for SSBM Nucleus, everything unlocked by default, Envoy (the roguelike mode), Turbo and steadier netplay, a native Qt launcher with a Diagnostics tab, opt-in crash report upload, and afterimages and tracers for technique. New branch work is not included just because it is pushed.

**Next**
Linux performance: on some Linux laptops the game runs below 60 fps, which also slows an online match with a Windows player. Broader Linux gameplay, audio and controller acceptance continues.

**Roguelite campaign**
Development now includes branching room generation, save/resume, encounters, rewards, inventory/equipment, gene actions and loadout/HUD integration. Production room recipes remain uncertified; generated-route admission and watched gameplay checks are still pending.

**Editor + scripting**
The map editor supports gizmos, multi-select, undo/redo and spawn editing. Lua stage/model tools and fighter effects continue to grow.

See the development links below. Report the version or branch/commit when testing.

posts.title: GET GD'S MELEE
posts.text:
**Latest public release: v0.2.2 (Windows + Linux)**
Download from the official release Assets. Add your own Melee NTSC 1.02 disc image. Game data is not included.

**Windows:** GDMelee-0.2.2-win64.zip. Extract it, run GD Melee.exe, pick your disc image and press PLAY.
**Linux:** GDMelee-0.2.2-linux-x86_64.tar.xz. Extract it to a new folder and run ./GD-Melee from the melee-linux-i686 folder. If it stops with "No supported adapters", try MELEE_BACKEND=opengles ./GD-Melee.

**Online**
Use VERSUS > ONLINE. Windows and Linux 0.2.2 play each other (netplay protocol 5). Every player needs 0.2.2; 0.2.1 and earlier cannot match it. Match your opponent's disc/mod content.

**Known issues**
Some Linux laptops run below 60 fps, which also slows online matches with Windows players.

For help, include version or commit, operating system, GPU, controller and exact error in #help-and-setup.

posts.title: MADE IN THE WORKSHOP
posts.text:
Share clips, combos, original art, mods, scripts, map-editor layouts and campaign experiments.

Include your build or branch/commit, content and what the clip demonstrates. Label development footage, certification fixtures and prototypes clearly. A development clip does not mean the feature is in the public release.

Credit collaborators and link source when possible. Share original work and patches; game discs and extracted game assets stay off the server.

posts.title: BUILD SOMETHING
posts.text:
**Lua, kit UI and map editing**
Use gd.* / gd.kit for gameplay scripts and UI, stage collision/models, camera tools and the LAB. The map editor has gizmos, multi-select, undo/redo, saved layouts and spawn editing.

**Fighters and effects**
m-ex compatibility and Ultimate fighter conversion/effect tooling continue in development. Installed content and visual fidelity need their own verification.

**Campaign development**
The roguelite modules cover routes, persistence, encounters, rewards, inventory, gene actions and presentation. Room certification and gameplay acceptance remain pending; do not treat a planned feature or passing module test as a finished campaign.

The current development links are below. Include your branch/commit and a small reproduction when sharing code or reporting a problem. Share original work, source and patches with credits; no disc-derived assets.
